US Pentagon Reinstates Testosterone Screening for Male Service Members Over 30

The US Pentagon has reinstated a mandatory testosterone screening policy for male service members aged 30 and over. This policy, previously paused, aims to ensure service members can operate at their "absolute best," according to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. The move comes amid concerns raised by medical experts regarding potential risks associated with the screening and its implications for readiness. The policy was also updated to remove guidance related to female hormones.
